新增:
编辑图片
发送回复或查看图片时可编辑图片，支持裁剪、打码、标注与添加文字

楼中楼样式
可在外观设置中选择「时间线」或「经典」样式

收起楼中楼
楼中楼可收起为一行，显示回复者头像与回复数；可在外观设置中设为默认收起
改进:
楼中楼就地展开
回复直接在楼层下展开，无需跳转；较长的回复先显示部分内容

「我的」页
收藏与浏览记录置于顶部，显示新回复数与最近浏览的帖子

夜间模式
可在「我的」页顶栏一键切换；主题跟随系统时，不改动主题设置

平板搜索
侧边栏旁的搜索移至顶栏末端

无障碍改进
改进读屏朗读与操作
修复: 吧页面刷新后顶栏与标签行显示异常
从吧页面打开的帖子返回时，未收回原卡片
打开新页面时，上一页的标题消失或停在屏幕边缘
取消返回手势时页面短暂停顿
首页底栏滑动时无法及时收起
部分网络环境下无法登录
搜索页排序标签显示异常
平板上页面滑出时遮挡侧边栏，切换标签后搜索未关闭
帖子页底栏滑动时无法收起
部分图片无法保存或分享
壁纸主题下分段选择器显示异常

New:
Edit pictures
Edit pictures on a reply before sending, or from the photo viewer: crop, redact, mark up and add text

Comment style
Choose Timeline or Classic in Appearance

Collapse comments
Comments can fold into one line showing who replied and how many; set them to start collapsed in Appearance
Improved:
Comments in place
Comments open under their reply without leaving the thread; long ones show in part first

Me tab
Stored threads and history sit at the top, with new replies and the thread you read last

Night mode
Switch it in one tap from the Me tab's bar; while following the system, your theme setting stays as it was

Search on tablets
Beside the navigation rail, search sits at the end of the top bar
Fixed: The bar and tabs showed incorrectly after refreshing a forum
Going back from a thread opened in a forum didn't return it to its card
Opening a page made the previous page's title vanish or stick at the screen's edge
Calling off a back gesture briefly paused the page
The home bottom bar didn't fold in time while scrolling
Signing in failed on some networks
The sortable tab on the search page showed incorrectly
On tablets, pages sliding out covered the navigation rail, and search stayed open after switching tabs
The thread's bottom bar didn't slide away while scrolling
Some pictures couldn't be saved or shared
Segmented controls showed incorrectly on the wallpaper theme
